info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: searchIndexes lists every Meilisearch index with its document count.
get.description:
searchIndexes lists every Meilisearch index with its document count. Creation
and last-indexed timestamps ride along. An unreachable upstream reads as an empty
index list, never a 5xx, so the console panel degrades to an honest empty state.

get.summary: searchStats totals the documents across every Meilisearch index.
get.description:
searchStats totals the documents across every Meilisearch index. Query counters
are reported as an honest zero: Meilisearch keeps no query history, so searches,
sessions and the per-day series are not derivable from the index.

get.summary: vectorCollections lists every Qdrant collection with its vector count.
get.description:
vectorCollections lists every Qdrant collection with its vector count. Dimension
and distance metric ride along. An unreachable upstream reads as an empty
collection list.

get.summary: vectorStats sums the Qdrant collections into three headline totals.
get.description:
vectorStats sums the Qdrant collections into three headline totals. Those are
collections, vectors and stored bytes. An unreachable upstream reads as zeros.

count.description: Count is the number of searches in that day.

createdAt.description:
CreatedAt is the index creation time, now() when the upstream did not
report one.

docCount.description: DocCount is how many documents the index currently holds.

lastIndexedAt.description:
LastIndexedAt is the index's last update time, null when the upstream did
not report one.

indexes.description:
Indexes is every index, sorted by name. Empty when the upstream is
unreachable.

searchesPerDay.description: SearchesPerDay is always empty — the series is not derivable from the index.

totalDocuments.description: TotalDocuments is the summed document count across every index.

totalSearches.description: TotalSearches is always 0 — Meilisearch keeps no query-history counter.

totalSessions.description: TotalSessions is always 0, for the same reason as TotalSearches.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is the collection creation time when the upstream reports it.

dimension.description: Dimension is the configured vector size.

distanceMetric.description:
DistanceMetric is the configured distance, "cosine" when the upstream did
not report one.

storageBytes.description: StorageBytes is the collection's on-disk size when the upstream reports it.

vectorCount.description: VectorCount is the collection's point count.

collections.description:
Collections is every collection, sorted by name. Empty when the upstream is
unreachable.

totalCollections.description: TotalCollections is how many collections exist.

totalStorageBytes.description: TotalStorageBytes is the summed on-disk size across every collection.

totalVectors.description: TotalVectors is the summed point count across every collection.
